a.lede: Anthropic announced that its internal AI models undergoing "high-risk and cybersecurity evaluations" no longer have internet access following incidents involving U.S. government websites at the federal, state, and local levels. [...]
a.title: Anthropic takes risky AI tests offline after models breach govt sites

b.lede: Anthropic said it "turned off live internet access" for "all our internal evaluations" until further notice.
b.title: Anthropic can’t reliably control its AI agents. It’s cutting off its internal evals from the live internet instead
